questions.questionText: Which two types of files can be imported to generate a knowledge base for use with a Microsoft Foundry Agent? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.
questions.translation: ¿Cuáles dos tipos de archivos se pueden importar para generar una base de conocimiento para usarla con un Microsoft Foundry Agent? Cada respuesta correcta presenta una solución completa.
questions.explanation: DOC files and PDF files (both structured and unstructured) can be imported to generate a knowledge base for use with Azure AI Bot Service. ZIP files must first be extracted before they can be imported. MP4 files and CSV files are not supported to generate question-and-answer pairs for use with Azure AI Bot Service.

questions.questionText:
Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence.

[Answer choice] can search, classify, and compare sources of text for similarity.
questions.translation:
Selecciona la respuesta que completa correctamente la oración.

[Opción de respuesta] puede buscar, clasificar y comparar fuentes de texto por similitud.
questions.explanation: Embeddings is an Azure OpenAI model that converts text into numerical vectors for analysis. Embeddings can be used to search, classify, and compare sources of text for similarity.

questions.questionText: Which two capabilities are examples of a GPT model? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.
questions.translation: ¿Cuáles dos capacidades son ejemplos de un modelo GPT? Cada respuesta correcta presenta una solución completa.
options: B. Detect specific dialects of a language.
C. Generate closed captions in real-time from a video.
questions.correctAnswer: A. Create natural language., E. Understand natural language.
questions.explanation: Azure OpenAI natural language models can take in natural language and generate responses. GPT models are excellent at both understanding and creating natural language. Detecting dialects, generating captions, and synthesizing speech are capabilities of other Azure AI services.

questions.questionText: Which Azure Language in Foundry Tools feature allows you to analyze written articles to extract information and concepts, such as people and locations, for classification purposes?
questions.translation: ¿Qué característica de Azure Language en Foundry Tools te permite analizar artículos escritos para extraer información y conceptos, como personas y lugares, con fines de clasificación?
questions.explanation: Named entity recognition can identify and categorize entities in unstructured text, such as people, places, organizations, and quantities, and is suitable to support the development of an article recommendation system. Key phrase extraction, Content Moderator, and the PII feature are not suited to entity recognition tasks to build a recommender system.

questions.questionText: What are two capabilities of generative AI models? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.
questions.translation: ¿Cuáles son dos capacidades de los modelos de IA generativa? Cada respuesta correcta presenta una solución completa.
options: A. generating new content based on training data
C. classifying data into predefined categories, such as spam and non-spam email messages
D. detecting patterns in structured datasets for predictive analysis
E. summarizing text and generating translations
questions.correctAnswer: A. generating new content based on training data, E. summarizing text and generating translations
questions.explanation: Generative AI models can generate new content (text, images, code) based on patterns learned from training data, and can summarize and translate text. Identifying objects in images is a computer vision task. Classifying data into predefined categories and detecting patterns for predictive analysis are traditional machine learning tasks, not generative AI.

questions.questionText: Which artificial intelligence (AI) workload scenario is an example of natural language processing (NLP)?
questions.translation: ¿Cuál escenario de carga de trabajo de inteligencia artificial (IA) es un ejemplo de procesamiento de lenguaje natural (NLP)?
options: A. extracting key phrases from a business insights report
B. identifying objects in landscape images
C. monitoring for sudden increases in quantity of failed sign-in attempts
D. predicting whether customers are likely to buy a product based on previous purchases
questions.correctAnswer: A. extracting key phrases from a business insights report
questions.explanation: Extracting key phrases from text to identify the main terms is an NLP workload. Predicting whether customers are likely to buy a product based on previous purchases requires a machine learning model. Monitoring for sudden increases in failed sign-in attempts is an anomaly detection workload. Identifying objects in landscape images is a computer vision workload.

questions.questionText: Which generative AI model is used to generate images based on natural language prompts?
questions.translation: ¿Qué modelo de IA generativa se usa para generar imágenes basadas en indicaciones de lenguaje natural?
questions.explanation: DALL-E is a model that can generate images from natural language prompts. GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 can understand and generate natural language and code, but not images. Embeddings converts text into numerical vectors to facilitate text similarity. Whisper can transcribe and translate speech to text.

questions.questionText:
You are exploring solutions to improve the document search and indexing service for employees.

You need an artificial intelligence (AI) search solution that will include searching text in various types of documents, such as images.

Which type of AI workload is this?
questions.translation:
Estás explorando soluciones para mejorar el servicio de búsqueda e indexación de documentos para empleados.

Necesitas una solución de búsqueda con inteligencia artificial (IA) que incluya la búsqueda de texto en varios tipos de documentos, como imágenes.

¿Qué tipo de carga de trabajo de IA es esta?
questions.explanation: Data mining workloads primarily focus on the searching and indexing of data. Computer vision can extract information from images but is not a search and indexing solution. Conversational AI is part of NLP and facilitates chatbot creation. Semantic segmentation classifies individual pixels in images. Anomaly detection finds outliers in data such as unusual credit card activity — it is not used for searching and indexing.

questions.questionText: Which principle of responsible artificial intelligence (AI) ensures that an AI system meets any legal and ethical standards it must abide by?
questions.translation: ¿Qué principio de la inteligencia artificial (IA) responsable garantiza que un sistema de IA cumpla con los estándares legales y éticos que debe seguir?
questions.explanation: The accountability principle ensures that AI systems are designed to meet any ethical and legal standards that are applicable. The privacy and security principle states that AI systems must be designed to protect personal and/or sensitive data. The inclusiveness principle states that AI systems must empower people in a positive and engaging way. The fairness principle ensures that users of AI systems are treated fairly.

questions.questionText: Which Azure AI Service for Language feature can be used to analyze online user reviews to identify whether users view a product positively or negatively?
questions.translation: ¿Qué característica de Azure AI Service para idioma puede usarse para analizar reseñas de usuarios en línea e identificar si ven un producto de forma positiva o negativa?
questions.explanation: Sentiment analysis provides sentiment labels — negative, neutral, and positive — based on a confidence score from text analysis. This makes it suitable for understanding user sentiment in product reviews. Named entity recognition, key phrase extraction, and language detection cannot perform sentiment analysis for product reviews.

questions.questionText: Which two artificial intelligence (AI) workload scenarios are examples of natural language processing (NLP)? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.
questions.translation: ¿Cuáles dos escenarios de carga de trabajo de inteligencia artificial (IA) son ejemplos de procesamiento de lenguaje natural (NLP)? Cada respuesta correcta presenta una solución completa.
options: A. extracting handwritten text from online images
B. generating tags and descriptions for images
C. monitoring network traffic for sudden spikes
D. performing sentiment analysis on social media data
E. translating text between different languages from product reviews
questions.correctAnswer: D. performing sentiment analysis on social media data, E. translating text between different languages from product reviews
questions.explanation: Translating text between different languages from product reviews is an NLP workload that uses the Azure Translator in Foundry Tools service. It can provide text translation of supported languages in real time. Performing sentiment analysis on social media data is an NLP workload that uses the sentiment analysis feature of the Azure AI Service for Language, providing sentiment labels such as negative, neutral, and positive for text-based sentences and documents.

questions.questionText: Which principle of responsible artificial intelligence (AI) defines the framework of governance and organization principles that meet ethical and legal standards of AI solutions?
questions.translation: ¿Qué principio de la inteligencia artificial (IA) responsable define el marco de gobernanza y principios organizacionales que cumplen con los estándares éticos y legales de las soluciones de IA?
questions.explanation: Accountability defines the framework of governance and organizational principles, which are meant to ensure that AI solutions meet ethical and legal standards that are clearly defined. The other answer choices do not define the framework of governance and organization principles, but provide guidance regarding the ethical and legal aspects of the corresponding standards.

questions.questionText: Which computer vision service provides bounding coordinates as part of its output?
questions.translation: ¿Qué servicio de visión por computadora proporciona coordenadas de delimitación (bounding box) como parte de su salida?
questions.explanation: Object detection generates bounding boxes that identify the locations of different types of objects in an image, including the bounding box coordinates designating the location of the object. Semantic segmentation classifies individual pixels in an image. Image classification classifies images based on their contents. Image analysis extracts information from the image to label it with tags or captions.

questions.questionText: As per the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, what is the first stage to consider when developing a responsible generative AI solution?
questions.translation: Según el Marco de Gestión de Riesgos de IA del NIST, ¿cuál es la primera etapa a considerar al desarrollar una solución de IA generativa responsable?
options: B. Measure the presence of potential harms.
questions.explanation: Identifying potential harms is the first stage when planning a responsible generative AI solution. After identifying harms, you measure their presence, then mitigate them, and finally operate the solution with ongoing monitoring.

questions.questionText:
A bank is developing a new artificial intelligence (AI) system to support the process of accepting or rejecting mortgage applications.

Which two issues should be considered as part of the responsible AI principle of fairness to avoid biased decision making? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.
questions.translation:
Un banco está desarrollando un nuevo sistema de inteligencia artificial (IA) para apoyar el proceso de aceptar o rechazar solicitudes de hipoteca.

¿Cuáles dos aspectos deben considerarse como parte del principio de equidad de la IA responsable para evitar decisiones sesgadas? Cada respuesta correcta presenta parte de la solución.
questions.explanation: The AI system must be designed to ensure that biased decision making is avoided and not based on factors such as ethnicity and gender. The system will consider salary, payment history, and credit utilization as standard financial metrics — these are legitimate factors for mortgage decisions and do not introduce bias.

questions.questionText: Which three values are returned by the language detection feature of the Azure Language in Foundry Tools service in Azure?
questions.translation: ¿Cuáles tres valores devuelve la característica de detección de idioma del servicio Azure Language en Foundry Tools?
questions.correctAnswer: B. ISO 6391 Code, C. Language Name, D. Score
questions.explanation: Language Name, ISO 6391 Code, and Score are the three values returned by the language detection feature of the Azure Language service. Bounding box coordinates are returned by the Azure Vision in Foundry Tools services, not the language service. Wikipedia URL is a potential value returned by entity linking in entity recognition, not language detection.

questions.questionText: What can be used for an attendance system that can scan handwritten signatures?
questions.translation: ¿Qué se puede utilizar para un sistema de asistencia que pueda escanear firmas escritas a mano?
questions.explanation: OCR is used to extract text and handwriting from images. In this case, it can be used to extract signatures for attendance purposes. Face detection can detect and verify human faces, not text, from images. Object detection can detect multiple objects in an image using bounding box coordinates but is not used to extract handwritten text. Image classification is concerned with the primary contents of an image.

questions.questionText: Which computer vision solution provides the ability to identify a person's age based on a photograph?
questions.translation: ¿Qué solución de visión por computadora ofrece la capacidad de identificar la edad de una persona a partir de una fotografía?
questions.explanation: Facial detection provides the ability to detect and analyze human faces in an image, including identifying a person's age based on a photograph. Image classification classifies images based on their contents. Object detection generates bounding boxes identifying the locations of objects in an image. Semantic segmentation classifies individual pixels in an image.

questions.questionText: Which natural language processing (NLP) technique assigns values to words such as plant and flower, so that they are considered closer to each other than a word such as airplane?
questions.translation: ¿Qué técnica de procesamiento de lenguaje natural (NLP) asigna valores a palabras como 'planta' y 'flor', de modo que se consideren más cercanas entre sí que una palabra como 'avión'?
questions.explanation: Vectorization captures semantic relationships between words by assigning them to locations in n-dimensional space, so semantically similar words (like plant and flower) are positioned closer together. Lemmatization (also known as stemming) normalizes words before counting them. Frequency analysis counts how often a word appears in a text. N-grams extend frequency analysis to include multi-term phrases.

questions.questionText: Which additional piece of information is included with each phrase returned by an image description task of the Azure Vision in Foundry Tools?
questions.translation: ¿Qué información adicional se incluye con cada frase devuelta por una tarea de descripción de imagen de Azure Vision en Foundry Tools?
questions.explanation: Each phrase returned by an image description task of the Azure Vision in Foundry Tools includes the confidence score, which indicates how certain the model is about the description. An endpoint and a key must be provided to access the service but are not returned per phrase. Bounding box coordinates are returned by services such as object detection, but not image description.

questions.questionText:
You are using a generative AI solution.

You need to ensure that users understand the purpose of the solution and the potential impact of its outputs.

Which responsible AI risk should you identify and mitigate?
questions.translation:
Estás utilizando una solución de IA generativa.

Necesitas garantizar que los usuarios entiendan el propósito de la solución y el impacto potencial de sus resultados.

¿Qué riesgo de IA responsable debes identificar y mitigar?
questions.explanation: Lack of transparency is correct because ensuring that users understand the purpose of a generative AI solution and the potential impact of its outputs is a core aspect of the transparency principle of responsible AI. Transparency focuses on making it clear to users how and why an AI system is used and what its outputs represent. Adversarial vulnerability relates to security and robustness, bias or unfair outcomes relate to fairness, and lack of accessibility relates to inclusiveness.

questions.questionText:
Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence.

To refine a prompt for an image-generation model in Microsoft Foundry, [Answer choice] helps guide the generated image.
questions.translation:
Selecciona la respuesta que completa correctamente la oración.

Para refinar un prompt para un modelo de generación de imágenes en Microsoft Foundry, [Opción de respuesta] ayuda a guiar la imagen generada.
options: A. a simple list of objects in the scene
B. extracted labels from image analysis
C. the model deployment name and image size
D. visual details about the subject, setting, and style
questions.correctAnswer: D. visual details about the subject, setting, and style
questions.explanation: Visual details about the subject, setting, and style help the image-generation model produce an output that matches the intended appearance. A simple list of objects gives limited guidance, extracted labels from image analysis describe existing images rather than guiding new ones, and the model deployment name and image size are configuration details rather than prompt details.

questions.questionText:
You have a Python app that submits product demonstration videos to Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools.

You need to update the app to read built-in audiovisual elements that include:
• speaker-attributed speech segments with start and end times
• timestamps for representative visual frames

Which two elements should the app read? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.translation:
Tienes una aplicación Python que envía videos de demostración de productos a Azure Content Understanding en Foundry Tools.

Necesitas actualizar la aplicación para leer elementos audiovisuales integrados que incluyen:
• segmentos de voz atribuidos a oradores con tiempos de inicio y fin
• marcas de tiempo para fotogramas visuales representativos

¿Cuáles dos elementos debe leer la aplicación? Cada respuesta correcta presenta parte de la solución.
options: E. The width and height properties
questions.correctAnswer: A. The transcriptPhrases array, B. The keyFrameTimesMs array
questions.explanation: The keyFrameTimesMs array provides timestamps for representative key frames selected from the video, and the transcriptPhrases array provides speaker-attributed speech segments with start and end times. The cameraShotTimesMs array identifies camera shot changes rather than representative key frames, the fields object contains extracted schema fields, and the width and height properties describe video dimensions rather than time-based speech or visual moments.

questions.questionText:
Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence.

After creating an AIProjectClient, a Python chat app should [Answer choice] before sending prompts to a deployed model.
questions.translation:
Selecciona la respuesta que completa correctamente la oración.

Después de crear un AIProjectClient, una aplicación de chat en Python debe [Opción de respuesta] antes de enviar prompts a un modelo desplegado.
options: B. send prompts by using deployments operations
C. create a client from the deployment name only
D. use the deployment URL as the project endpoint
questions.explanation: Calling get_openai_client() is correct because it obtains the authenticated OpenAI-compatible client used to send model requests through the Foundry project. A deployment name alone does not provide the client endpoint and authentication, deployments operations are for working with deployed model metadata rather than sending chat prompts, and AIProjectClient uses the Foundry project endpoint rather than a model deployment URL.

questions.questionText:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project that analyzes product images.

You need Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools to provide:
• descriptive text that can be indexed for image search
• a structured product category value

Which two actions should you perform? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.translation:
Tienes un proyecto de Microsoft Foundry que analiza imágenes de productos.

Necesitas que Azure Content Understanding en Foundry Tools proporcione:
• texto descriptivo que se pueda indexar para búsqueda de imágenes
• un valor estructurado de categoría de producto

¿Cuáles dos acciones debes realizar? Cada respuesta correcta presenta parte de la solución.
options: A. Add a schema field that uses classify for the product category
B. Map source locations to the search index content field
C. Map the Markdown output to the search index content field
D. Configure Azure AI Content Safety image moderation categories
questions.correctAnswer: A. Add a schema field that uses classify for the product category, C. Map the Markdown output to the search index content field
questions.explanation: Adding a schema field that uses classify returns a structured category value for downstream classification, and mapping the Markdown output provides descriptive content that can be indexed for image search. Azure AI Content Safety image moderation categories are used to detect potentially harmful content, and source locations identify where content came from rather than providing searchable descriptive text.

questions.questionText:
You have a Python app that stores generated replies in a variable named response_text.

You need to use Azure Speech in Foundry Tools to synthesize response_text by using the en-US-Ava:DragonHDLatestNeural voice and play the audio on the default speaker.

Which configuration should the app use?
questions.translation:
Tienes una aplicación Python que almacena respuestas generadas en una variable llamada response_text.

Necesitas usar Azure Speech en Foundry Tools para sintetizar response_text con la voz en-US-Ava:DragonHDLatestNeural y reproducir el audio en el altavoz predeterminado.

¿Qué configuración debe usar la aplicación?
options: B. speech_synthesis_language and default speaker output
C. speech_synthesis_voice_name and default speaker output
questions.correctAnswer: C. speech_synthesis_voice_name and default speaker output
questions.explanation: The app should configure speech_synthesis_voice_name to use the required voice and default speaker output to play the synthesized audio locally. Setting only the synthesis language does not select the required specific voice, and file output writes the audio to a file instead of playing it through the default speaker.

questions.questionText:
For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

1. Foundry Tools can be used to discover, configure, and add tools to an agent.
2. Built-in tools require you to host external code before they can be added to an agent.
3. In the Foundry portal, selecting a model defines how an agent should behave when responding to users.
questions.translation:
Para cada una de las siguientes afirmaciones, selecciona Sí si la afirmación es verdadera. De lo contrario, selecciona No.

1. Foundry Tools se puede usar para descubrir, configurar y agregar herramientas a un agente.
2. Las herramientas integradas requieren que aloje código externo antes de poder agregarlas a un agente.
3. En el portal de Foundry, seleccionar un modelo define cómo debe comportarse un agente al responder a los usuarios.
questions.explanation: Foundry Tools is used to discover and configure tools for agents (statement 1 is true). Built-in tools are preconfigured capabilities that can be enabled for an agent without hosting external code (statement 2 is false). Selecting a model does not define the agent's behavior — instructions define behavior, while the model provides the underlying generation capability (statement 3 is false).

questions.questionText:
For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

1. Image generation models in Microsoft Foundry can create images from natural-language descriptions.
2. Image generation models in Microsoft Foundry retrieve generated images from a curated image catalog.
3. The Microsoft Foundry model catalog can be filtered by inference task to help find text-to-image models.
questions.translation:
Para cada una de las siguientes afirmaciones, selecciona Sí si la afirmación es verdadera. De lo contrario, selecciona No.

1. Los modelos de generación de imágenes en Microsoft Foundry pueden crear imágenes a partir de descripciones en lenguaje natural.
2. Los modelos de generación de imágenes en Microsoft Foundry recuperan imágenes de un catálogo de imágenes curado.
3. El catálogo de modelos de Microsoft Foundry se puede filtrar por tarea de inferencia para encontrar modelos de texto a imagen.
questions.explanation: Image generation models can create images from natural-language prompts (statement 1 is true). They generate new images rather than retrieve completed images from a curated catalog (statement 2 is false). The Microsoft Foundry model catalog supports filtering by inference task, which helps find models for tasks such as text-to-image generation (statement 3 is true).

questions.questionText:
Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence.

In Microsoft Foundry, a system message is used to [Answer choice]
questions.translation:
Selecciona la respuesta que completa correctamente la oración.

En Microsoft Foundry, un mensaje del sistema se usa para [Opción de respuesta]
options: C. guide role, style, and boundaries.
questions.correctAnswer: C. guide role, style, and boundaries.
questions.explanation: A system message is used to guide the model's role, response style, and behavioral boundaries for a generative AI app. It does not change model training data, evaluate responses after generation, or replace safety controls — those are separate mechanisms.

questions.questionText:
Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence.

In Microsoft Foundry, an app that accepts spoken input and an image requires a deployed [Answer choice]
questions.translation:
Selecciona la respuesta que completa correctamente la oración.

En Microsoft Foundry, una aplicación que acepta entrada de voz e imagen requiere un [Opción de respuesta] desplegado.
questions.explanation: A deployed multimodal model is correct because the app must process more than one input type — including speech and image content — and generate a response. An embedding model creates vector representations, an image generation model creates images from prompts, and Prompt Shield helps detect prompt injection attacks rather than processing multimodal input.

questions.questionText:
For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

1. Language detection in Azure Language in Foundry Tools redacts personally identifiable information from submitted text.
2. Language detection in Azure Language in Foundry Tools identifies sentiment in submitted text and returns confidence scores.
3. Language detection in Azure Language in Foundry Tools identifies the primary language of submitted text and returns a confidence score.
questions.translation:
Para cada una de las siguientes afirmaciones, selecciona Sí si la afirmación es verdadera. De lo contrario, selecciona No.

1. La detección de idioma en Azure Language en Foundry Tools redacta información de identificación personal del texto enviado.
2. La detección de idioma en Azure Language en Foundry Tools identifica el sentimiento del texto enviado y devuelve puntuaciones de confianza.
3. La detección de idioma en Azure Language en Foundry Tools identifica el idioma principal del texto enviado y devuelve una puntuación de confianza.
questions.explanation: Language detection identifies the primary language of submitted text and returns a confidence score, so the third statement is true. Identifying sentiment is a sentiment analysis capability, and redacting personally identifiable information is a PII detection capability — neither is a function of language detection.

questions.questionText:
You have a Python app that uses the OpenAI Responses API in Microsoft Foundry with a deployed multimodal model.

Users provide two HTTPS image URLs.

You need the app to return a text comparison of the two images in a single request.

What should the request include?
questions.translation:
Tienes una aplicación Python que usa la API de Respuestas de OpenAI en Microsoft Foundry con un modelo multimodal desplegado.

Los usuarios proporcionan dos URLs de imágenes HTTPS.

Necesitas que la aplicación devuelva una comparación de texto de las dos imágenes en una sola solicitud.

¿Qué debe incluir la solicitud?
options: A. Each image URL sent to an image-generation endpoint
B. A text instruction and each image URL as an input_image content part
C. Each image URL as an image_url content part in Chat Completions format
D. A text instruction and each image URL combined into one input_text value
questions.correctAnswer: B. A text instruction and each image URL as an input_image content part
questions.explanation: The request should include a text instruction and each image URL as an input_image content part because the model must receive both images as visual input and return a text comparison. Combining image URLs into text does not provide the images as visual input, Chat Completions format does not match the Responses API content-part names, and an image-generation endpoint creates images rather than comparing existing images.

questions.questionText:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project that contains a deployed image-generation model.

You need a Python web app to create a 1024 x 1024 image from a user's natural-language prompt and display the image in a browser.

Which request pattern should the app use?
questions.translation:
Tienes un proyecto de Microsoft Foundry que contiene un modelo de generación de imágenes desplegado.

Necesitas una aplicación web Python para crear una imagen de 1024 x 1024 a partir de un prompt en lenguaje natural del usuario y mostrarla en un navegador.

¿Qué patrón de solicitud debe usar la aplicación?
options: A. Send the prompt to the image embeddings endpoint and render the returned vectors
B. Send the prompt to the image generations endpoint and decode the returned image data
C. Send the prompt to the image generations endpoint and return the raw HTTP response body
D. Send the prompt to the image edits endpoint and upload an existing source image
questions.correctAnswer: B. Send the prompt to the image generations endpoint and decode the returned image data
questions.explanation: Sending the prompt to the image generations endpoint and decoding the returned image data is correct because the app must create a new image from a natural-language prompt and display the generated image. The image edits endpoint is used when starting from an existing image, the raw HTTP response body is not the generated image bytes returned by the image-generation response, and embeddings return vector representations rather than displayable images.

questions.questionText:
You have a Microsoft Foundry resource and recordings of customer support calls. Each recording contains an agent and a customer.

You need Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools to return agent/customer-attributed transcripts, summaries, and sentiment insights with minimal analyzer configuration.

Which analyzer should you use?
questions.translation:
Tienes un recurso de Microsoft Foundry y grabaciones de llamadas de soporte al cliente. Cada grabación contiene un agente y un cliente.

Necesitas que Azure Content Understanding en Foundry Tools devuelva transcripciones atribuidas por agente/cliente, resúmenes e información de sentimiento con una configuración mínima del analizador.

¿Qué analizador debes usar?
questions.explanation: The prebuilt-callCenter analyzer is correct because it is designed for post-call analysis and returns conversation transcripts with speaker role detection, call summaries, and call sentiment with minimal configuration. prebuilt-audioSearch is optimized for search and retrieval scenarios, a custom audio analyzer would require more configuration, and customizing prebuilt-audioSearch would not minimize analyzer configuration.

questions.questionText:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project.

You need to deploy an Azure OpenAI model for a chat app and apply guardrails.

Which deployment option should you use?
questions.translation:
Tienes un proyecto de Microsoft Foundry.

Necesitas desplegar un modelo de Azure OpenAI para una aplicación de chat y aplicar controles de seguridad (guardrails).

¿Qué opción de despliegue debes usar?
options: C. Standard deployment in Foundry resources
questions.correctAnswer: C. Standard deployment in Foundry resources
questions.explanation: Standard deployment in Foundry resources is correct because the scenario uses an Azure OpenAI model and requires an actual deployment that can be governed with guardrails. Instant access does not create a deployment, managed compute deployment is intended for partner and community models, and provisioned deployment type is a throughput-related deployment type rather than the deployment option being selected.

questions.questionText:
You have a Python app that collects short customer feedback comments.

You need to write a sentiment label and positive, neutral, and negative confidence scores for each comment. The solution must avoid training a custom model.

Which Azure Language in Foundry Tools feature should the app call?
questions.translation:
Tienes una aplicación Python que recopila comentarios cortos de retroalimentación de clientes.

Necesitas registrar una etiqueta de sentimiento y puntuaciones de confianza positivas, neutrales y negativas para cada comentario. La solución debe evitar entrenar un modelo personalizado.

¿Qué función de Azure Language en Foundry Tools debe llamar la aplicación?
questions.explanation: Sentiment analysis is correct because it returns sentiment labels and confidence scores for positive, neutral, and negative sentiment from text. Key phrase extraction identifies important terms, language detection identifies the language of the text, and PII detection identifies sensitive personal information — none of these return sentiment labels or confidence scores.

questions.questionText:
For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

1. The OpenAI Responses API in Microsoft Foundry supports a single request that includes both text input and image input.
2. Images sent to a vision-enabled model by using the OpenAI Responses API can be provided as publicly accessible URLs, but not as base64-encoded image data.
3. Application code that uses a deployed Foundry model with the OpenAI Python SDK passes the base model name instead of the deployment name as the model value.
questions.translation:
Para cada una de las siguientes afirmaciones, selecciona Sí si la afirmación es verdadera. De lo contrario, selecciona No.

1. La API de Respuestas de OpenAI en Microsoft Foundry admite una sola solicitud que incluye tanto entrada de texto como entrada de imagen.
2. Las imágenes enviadas a un modelo habilitado para visión mediante la API de Respuestas de OpenAI se pueden proporcionar como URLs de acceso público, pero no como datos de imagen codificados en base64.
3. El código de aplicación que usa un modelo Foundry desplegado con el SDK de Python de OpenAI pasa el nombre del modelo base en lugar del nombre del despliegue como valor del model.
questions.explanation: The OpenAI Responses API in Microsoft Foundry supports requests that include both text input and image input, so the first statement is true. Images can be provided by URL or as base64-encoded data, so the second statement is false. The model value should be the deployment name in the Foundry project rather than the base model name, so the third statement is false.

questions.questionText:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project that receives images of retail store shelves.

You need to extract product brands, product counts, and shelf condition from each image as structured fields with confidence values.

What should you create?
questions.translation:
Tienes un proyecto de Microsoft Foundry que recibe imágenes de estantes de tiendas minoristas.

Necesitas extraer marcas de productos, conteos de productos y condición del estante de cada imagen como campos estructurados con valores de confianza.

¿Qué debes crear?
options: A. An Azure Content Understanding image analyzer with a field schema
B. An Azure AI Content Safety image moderation configuration
C. An Azure Vision in Foundry Tools Image Analysis request that uses OCR
D. An Azure Content Understanding document analyzer with a field schema
questions.correctAnswer: A. An Azure Content Understanding image analyzer with a field schema
questions.explanation: An Azure Content Understanding image analyzer with a field schema is correct because it can extract structured values from still images for downstream processing. Azure AI Content Safety image moderation flags potentially harmful content, a document analyzer is for document inputs rather than retail shelf images, and Azure Vision in Foundry Tools Image Analysis with OCR extracts visible text but does not return the required custom structured fields for brands, counts, and shelf condition.

questions.questionText:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project that contains a deployed Azure OpenAI model.

You need to submit prompts and review generated responses without writing code.

Which portal feature should you use?
questions.translation:
Tienes un proyecto de Microsoft Foundry que contiene un modelo de Azure OpenAI desplegado.

Necesitas enviar prompts y revisar las respuestas generadas sin escribir código.

¿Qué función del portal debes usar?
questions.explanation: The Chat playground is correct because it lets you submit prompts to a deployed model and review generated responses in the Foundry portal without writing code. The model catalog is used to find and select models, Models + endpoints is used to manage model deployments and endpoints, and monitoring metrics are used to review operational data rather than interactively test prompts.

questions.questionText:
For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

1. The recognize_once_async() method is used for long-running, multi-utterance speech recognition.
2. The recognize_once_async().get() call returns the recognition result for a single spoken utterance.
3. An AudioConfig object stores the endpoint or region and key used to connect to Azure Speech in Foundry Tools.
questions.translation:
Para cada una de las siguientes afirmaciones, selecciona Sí si la afirmación es verdadera. De lo contrario, selecciona No.

1. El método recognize_once_async() se usa para el reconocimiento de voz de múltiples expresiones de larga duración.
2. La llamada recognize_once_async().get() devuelve el resultado del reconocimiento para una sola expresión hablada.
3. Un objeto AudioConfig almacena el endpoint o la región y la clave usados para conectarse a Azure Speech en Foundry Tools.
questions.explanation: An AudioConfig object identifies the audio input source, while SpeechConfig stores the connection information for Azure Speech in Foundry Tools. The recognize_once_async() method is for single-utterance recognition, not long-running multi-utterance recognition. Calling .get() on the asynchronous recognition operation returns the recognition result for the spoken utterance.

questions.questionText:
For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

1. A user prompt can include an example to guide the model toward a desired style.
2. A user prompt can specify the intended audience to help tailor the response tone and technical depth.
3. A user prompt for structured output should omit requested formats such as bullet points, tables, or numbered lists.
questions.translation:
Para cada una de las siguientes afirmaciones, selecciona Sí si la afirmación es verdadera. De lo contrario, selecciona No.

1. Un prompt de usuario puede incluir un ejemplo para guiar al modelo hacia un estilo deseado.
2. Un prompt de usuario puede especificar la audiencia prevista para ayudar a adaptar el tono de respuesta y la profundidad técnica.
3. Un prompt de usuario para salida estructurada debe omitir los formatos solicitados como viñetas, tablas o listas numeradas.
questions.explanation: A user prompt can specify the intended audience to help the model tailor tone and technical depth, so the second statement is true. A prompt can include an example to guide the model toward the expected style or pattern, so the first statement is also true. A prompt for structured output should include the desired format rather than omit it, so the third statement is false.

questions.questionText:
You have scanned supplier forms that contain document fields and pricing tables.

You need Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools to return structured JSON for the fields and repeated table rows.

Which analyzer capability should you configure?
questions.translation:
Tienes formularios de proveedores escaneados que contienen campos de documentos y tablas de precios.

Necesitas que Azure Content Understanding en Foundry Tools devuelva JSON estructurado para los campos y las filas de tabla repetidas.

¿Qué capacidad del analizador debes configurar?
questions.explanation: Field extraction is correct because it returns structured values for fields and repeated rows. Classification categorizes documents, content extraction returns text and layout, and Markdown output structures extracted content for reading or search rather than returning schema-defined field and line-item values.

questions.questionText:
You have a Python app that uses a Microsoft Foundry project containing an existing prompt agent named faq-agent.

You need to configure the app to send a user message to the existing agent.

What should you do?
questions.translation:
Tienes una aplicación Python que usa un proyecto de Microsoft Foundry que contiene un agente de prompt existente llamado faq-agent.

Necesitas configurar la aplicación para enviar un mensaje de usuario al agente existente.

¿Qué debes hacer?
options: A. Create an ephemeral agent in the app
B. Call responses.create() with model set to faq-agent
C. Generate embeddings for the user message
D. Call responses.create() with an agent_reference
questions.correctAnswer: D. Call responses.create() with an agent_reference
questions.explanation: Calling responses.create() with an agent_reference is correct because it sends the user message to the existing agent definition in the Foundry project. Setting model to the agent name treats the agent as a model deployment, creating an ephemeral agent defines a new in-app agent instead of using the existing Foundry agent, and generating embeddings does not submit a message to an agent or display an agent response.

questions.questionText:
Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence.

Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools uses a schema to [Answer choice] for document analysis.
questions.translation:
Selecciona la respuesta que completa correctamente la oración.

Azure Content Understanding en Foundry Tools usa un esquema para [Opción de respuesta] en el análisis de documentos.
options: A. assign confidence scores to recognized text
B. capture text and layout from pages
C. define fields for extracted values
D. normalize files into supported formats
questions.correctAnswer: C. define fields for extracted values
questions.explanation: Defining fields for extracted values is correct because a Content Understanding schema specifies the structured information to extract from unstructured documents. Capturing text and layout is part of document analysis, confidence scores indicate extraction certainty, and file normalization is not the purpose of the schema.

questions.questionText:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project that contains an image-generation model.

You need an app to create a new product image by using an existing PNG image and a text prompt.

Which capability should the app use?
questions.translation:
Tienes un proyecto de Microsoft Foundry que contiene un modelo de generación de imágenes.

Necesitas una aplicación para crear una nueva imagen de producto usando una imagen PNG existente y un prompt de texto.

¿Qué capacidad debe usar la aplicación?
questions.explanation: Image-to-image editing is correct because the app starts with an existing image and uses a text prompt to create a new image based on it. Object detection identifies objects in an image, text embedding creates vector representations of text, and text-to-image generation creates an image from a prompt without using an existing image as the source.

questions.questionText:
You have a Python chat app that uses an OpenAI-compatible client from a Microsoft Foundry project.

You need to send a single prompt by using the unified model invocation API.

Which method should the app call?
questions.translation:
Tienes una aplicación de chat Python que usa un cliente compatible con OpenAI de un proyecto de Microsoft Foundry.

Necesitas enviar un único prompt usando la API unificada de invocación de modelos.

¿Qué método debe llamar la aplicación?
questions.explanation: The app should call responses.create() because it uses the Responses API to send a prompt and receive model output through an OpenAI-compatible client. chat.completions.create() uses the Chat Completions API instead, deployments.get() retrieves deployment metadata, and models.list() lists available models rather than sending a prompt.

questions.questionText:
Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence.

In Microsoft Foundry, generating a natural-language description of an uploaded image in the chat playground requires a deployed [Answer choice]
questions.translation:
Selecciona la respuesta que completa correctamente la oración.

En Microsoft Foundry, generar una descripción en lenguaje natural de una imagen cargada en el chat playground requiere un [Opción de respuesta] desplegado.
questions.explanation: A deployed multimodal model is correct because it can process image input and generate a natural-language response about the visual content. An image-generation model creates or edits images, a speech-to-text model transcribes audio, and a text-embedding model creates vector representations rather than image descriptions.

questions.questionText:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project that contains a deployed audio-capable Azure OpenAI model.

You need a Python app to send a recorded WAV question and receive both text and WAV audio output.

What should the app do?
questions.translation:
Tienes un proyecto de Microsoft Foundry que contiene un modelo de Azure OpenAI con capacidad de audio desplegado.

Necesitas una aplicación Python para enviar una pregunta WAV grabada y recibir tanto salida de texto como salida de audio WAV.

¿Qué debe hacer la aplicación?
options: A. Send the WAV file as input_audio and request only the text modality
B. Pass the WAV file name as input_audio and request text and audio modalities
C. Base64-encode the WAV file as input_audio and request text and audio modalities
D. Send the WAV file content as a text message and request text and audio modalities
questions.correctAnswer: C. Base64-encode the WAV file as input_audio and request text and audio modalities
questions.explanation: The app should base64-encode the WAV file as input_audio and request both text and audio modalities because the model must process spoken input and return both text and WAV audio output. Passing only the file name does not send the audio data, sending encoded audio as a text message does not identify it as audio input, and requesting only the text modality does not return an audio response.

questions.questionText:
Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence.

Key phrase extraction in Azure Language in Foundry Tools [Answer choice]
questions.translation:
Selecciona la respuesta que completa correctamente la oración.

La extracción de frases clave en Azure Language en Foundry Tools [Opción de respuesta]
options: A. detects the language of text.
B. identifies known entities with links.
C. identifies the main concepts in text.
D. identifies whether text is positive or negative.
questions.correctAnswer: C. identifies the main concepts in text.
questions.explanation: Key phrase extraction identifies the main concepts in text, which helps surface important words and phrases from unstructured content. Detecting the language of text is language detection, identifying known entities with links is entity linking, and identifying whether text is positive or negative is sentiment analysis.

questions.questionText:
You have a Python app that processes customer support messages by using Azure Language in Foundry Tools.

You need to extract people, locations, and organizations from each message, including the matching text and category.

Which client method should the app call?
questions.translation:
Tienes una aplicación Python que procesa mensajes de soporte al cliente usando Azure Language en Foundry Tools.

Necesitas extraer personas, ubicaciones y organizaciones de cada mensaje, incluyendo el texto coincidente y la categoría.

¿Qué método del cliente debe llamar la aplicación?
questions.explanation: The app should call recognize_entities because named entity recognition extracts entities from unstructured text and returns entity text with categories such as person, location, and organization. analyze_sentiment returns sentiment, extract_key_phrases returns important terms, and recognize_linked_entities identifies entities that can be linked to known knowledge-base entries rather than returning standard named entity categories.
